# Twilight of the Union: hand-written parts of the Soviet political focus tree.
# common/national_focus/TOTU_SOV.txt is generated by tools/build_focus_tree.py from the focus editor; the editor can
# only describe these effects in words. <focus id>_effect runs at the end of that focus's completion_reward.
# Tooltips and names: localisation/*/totu_sov_politics_l_*.yml. Events: events/TOTU_SOV_politics.txt.

### The Plenum (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-plenum-design.md; events/TOTU_SOV_plenum.txt) ###

# Picking the focus starts the preparation: three events while it runs. The focus cannot be cancelled.
SOV_central_committee_plenum_select_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_central_committee_plenum_select_tt
	set_country_flag = TOTU_plenum_preparing
	hidden_effect = {
		TOTU_pl_update_gfx = yes   # the status line of the plenum window
		country_event = { id = totu_plenum.1 days = 10 }
		country_event = { id = totu_plenum.2 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = totu_plenum.3 days = 50 }
	}
}

# The plenum sits for about 200 days; its vote opens one branch of the tree (TOTU_pl_conclude).
SOV_central_committee_plenum_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_central_committee_plenum_tt
	clr_country_flag = TOTU_plenum_preparing
	set_country_flag = TOTU_plenum_in_session
	hidden_effect = {
		TOTU_pl_update_gfx = yes
		country_event = { id = totu_plenum.11 days = 3 }
	}
}

# The party loses its constitutional monopoly, and with it much of its hold.
SOV_abolish_article_six_effect = {
	TOTU_pl_str_sub_15 = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		news_event = { id = totu_sov_news.1 hours = 6 }
	}
}

SOV_renew_the_party_effect = {
	TOTU_pl_str_add_5 = yes
}

### Centre ###

# 17 March 1991: 76.4% vote yes; the Baltic republics, Georgia, Armenia and Moldova boycott the vote.
SOV_union_referendum_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_union_referendum_tt
	set_country_flag = TOTU_union_referendum_held
	hidden_effect = {
		country_event = { id = totu_sov_politics.5 days = 1 }
		news_event = { id = totu_sov_news.4 hours = 6 }
	}
}

### Reforms ###

# The Press Law of June 1990: Glasnost grows stronger, with both its edges.
SOV_press_law_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_SOV_glasnost }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = TOTU_SOV_glasnost add_idea = TOTU_SOV_glasnost_free_press }
	}
}

# (Planned, not done yet: presidential decrees as decisions gated on TOTU_soviet_presidency.)
SOV_gorbachev_presidency_effect = {
	add_country_leader_trait = TOTU_president_of_the_ussr
	set_country_flag = TOTU_soviet_presidency
	hidden_effect = {
		news_event = { id = totu_sov_news.2 hours = 6 }
	}
}

SOV_vice_president_effect = {
	country_event = { id = totu_sov_politics.1 }
}

# The republican leaders get a seat in the centre: the republics' unrest weighs half as much.
SOV_federation_council_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_SOV_awakening_republics }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = TOTU_SOV_awakening_republics add_idea = TOTU_SOV_awakening_republics_council }
	}
}

# The generated reward swaps Awakening of the Republics for the Union of Sovereign States; this removes the softer
# Federation Council version if that is what the country has, and pays out Yeltsin's support.
SOV_union_of_sovereign_states_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_SOV_awakening_republics_council }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_SOV_awakening_republics_council
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_ally }
		custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_union_of_sovereign_states_yeltsin_tt
		add_stability = 0.05
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		news_event = { id = totu_sov_news.6 hours = 6 }
	}
}

# Left course
SOV_social_guarantees_effect = {
	add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_SOV_social_payments days = 365 }
}

# Right course
SOV_law_on_property_effect = {
	add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_SOV_cooperatives days = 365 }
}

SOV_500_days_program_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_500_days_program_tt
	set_country_flag = TOTU_500_days_adopted
	set_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_backs_500_days
	hidden_effect = {
		country_event = { id = totu_sov_politics.4 days = 1 }
	}
}

# Yeltsin: deal
SOV_deal_with_yeltsin_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_deal_with_yeltsin_tt
	set_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_ally
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_backs_500_days }
		custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_deal_with_yeltsin_500_days_tt
		add_stability = 0.03
	}
}

SOV_rsfsr_sovereignty_in_union_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_rsfsr_sovereignty_in_union_tt
	add_political_power = 50
	add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_SOV_rsfsr_budget days = 365 }
}

SOV_yeltsin_in_union_leadership_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = TOTU_vp_yanayev
				has_country_flag = TOTU_vp_shevardnadze
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_yeltsin_prime_minister_tt
		set_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_prime_minister
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_yeltsin_vice_president_tt
		set_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_vice_president
	}
	set_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_in_union_leadership
}

### Hardline ###

SOV_28th_party_congress_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_28th_party_congress_tt
	add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = 0.03 }
	add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.02 }
	set_country_flag = TOTU_yeltsin_left_cpsu
	hidden_effect = {
		country_event = { id = totu_sov_politics.3 days = 1 }
	}
}

# Gorbachev is kept at his dacha in Foros "for health reasons"; Yanayev, the face of the Emergency Committee, takes over.
# Event totu_sov_politics.7: the reaction of Yeltsin's Russia and the republics.
SOV_remove_gorbachev_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_remove_gorbachev_tt
	# recruited without a role in history/countries (recruit_character only works there), as vanilla does
	add_country_leader_role = {
		character = SOV_gennady_yanayev
		promote_leader = yes
		country_leader = {
			ideology = leninism
			expire = "2030.1.1.1"
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = TOTU_gorbachev_in_foros
	hidden_effect = {
		country_event = { id = totu_sov_politics.7 days = 1 }
		news_event = { id = totu_sov_news.5 hours = 6 }
	}
}

# The Intelligence Agency is a La Resistance feature; without it the money buys nothing the game can show.
SOV_kgb_budget_effect = {
	add_political_power = -50
	if = {
		limit = { has_dlc = "La Resistance" }
		if = {
			limit = { has_intelligence_agency = no }
			create_intelligence_agency = {
				name = "KGB"
				icon = GFX_intelligence_agency_logo_sov
			}
		}
		# decryption needs the cryptology department first (its "available" in intelligence_agency_upgrades)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_done_agency_upgrade = upgrade_form_department } }
			upgrade_intelligence_agency = upgrade_form_department
		}
		upgrade_intelligence_agency = upgrade_decryption_boost
	}
}

SOV_order_in_the_baltics_effect = {
	country_event = { id = totu_sov_politics.2 }
}

SOV_communist_party_of_rsfsr_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_communist_party_of_rsfsr_tt
	add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.03 }
	set_country_flag = TOTU_rsfsr_communist_party
}

SOV_state_of_emergency_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		news_event = { id = totu_sov_news.7 hours = 6 }
	}
}
